description: For each agency in a district and period: requests, how many are closed and not yet closed, and the median and average days to close (closed requests only). Optional problem and description filters. From BoardStat (BetaNYC, NYC Open Data, 2020 on); not an official City report. 311 counts are reports, not problems; 'closed' is not 'fixed'.

community_district.description: 306, BK06 or 'Brooklyn 6' (all forms: server instructions). Not with council_district.

council_district.description: Council district, 1 to 51. Not with community_district.

descriptions.description: 311 descriptors, e.g. ['Blocked Bike Lane']; a missing one is '(none)'.

exclude_descriptions.description: Leave out these descriptions instead of keeping only them.

last_days.description: The last N days of data, ending on the newest request's day (not today).

problems.description: BoardStat problem names, e.g. ['HEAT/HOT WATER']; any case.

name: agency_response
